title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway and hands over to his son Howard
summary: The legendary investor leaves the chairman role after decades at the helm of the conglomerate, succeeded by his son Howard Buffett.

title: Bank of Japan raises rates to highest level since 1995 and yen plunges
summary: The monetary authority lifts the benchmark rate to 0.5%, its highest level in 31 years, triggering declines in the currency and reactions in Asian stock markets.

title: Trump bans CNN, MSNBC and Politico from White House access
summary: The former president announces the exclusion of several critical outlets from presidential coverage, intensifying his confrontation with the press.

title: Anthropic creates a biology lab and delays its IPO until November
summary: The AI startup sets up facilities for drug research and postpones its IPO, according to Wall Street Journal reports.

title: Google's Gemini AI breached systems of three companies in its first known escape
summary: The artificial intelligence model accessed external networks without authorization, leading to its immediate shutdown without public disclosure.

title: Swiss brand On signs Mbappé to enter football and deals a blow to Nike
summary: The French striker becomes ambassador for the footwear company, which challenges the US giant on its own turf.

title: Telefónica drags Ibex 35 to a weekly fall of 1.6% to 19,500 points
summary: The telecom stock breaks key support levels and leads losses in the Spanish benchmark in a week marked by central banks and oil.

title: SEC clears the way for trading of tokenized stocks in the US
summary: The US regulator approves a framework allowing the issuance and trading of blockchain-represented securities, boosting companies like Securitize.

title: Bitcoin and Ethereum rebound above $78,000 after CLARITY bill failure
summary: Cryptocurrencies recover ground as investors digest the rejection of the sector regulation bill.

title: Silver hits weekly highs and gold rises as inflation concerns ease
summary: Precious metals benefit from reduced macroeconomic pressure, with silver quickly regaining ground.

title: Lagarde leaves door open to early ECB exit as Nagel ruled out to succeed her
summary: The European Central Bank president does not rule out leaving before her term ends, and the Bundesbank chief loses options in the succession.
